8.6.3.1. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.DirObj2DirObjPaths.__init__¶

DirObj2DirObjPaths.__init__(railyard, noPrefix=True, noSuffix=False, startCondition=None, endCondition=None, branch=True, posOrient=None, restriction=None, edgeCondition=None, gType='*', gTypeEnd=None, beginFacing=True, endFacing=True)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) – The railyard where the path-tuples are generated.
  • noPrefix (bool) – See __init__ of PathGenerator.
  • noSuffix (bool) – See __init__ of PathGenerator.
  • startCondition (any | none) – A callable having signature (obj, index, railyard) -> bool. If None, defaultTerminalCondition is used, which always returns True.
  • endCondition (any | none) – A callable having signature (obj, index, railyard) -> bool. If None, defaultTerminalCondition is used, which always returns True.
  • branch (bool) – See __init__ of PathGenerator.
  • posOrient (bool | none) – See __init__ of PathGenerator.
  • restriction (none | IPath | IGraph) – Generation of path-tuples are carried out in the path or area.
  • edgeCondition (any | none) – A callable having signature (processedNodeIndex, newNodeIndex, railyard) -> bool that is used determine if the edge from processedNodeIndex to newNodeIndex is a valid edge. If {None}, defaultEdgeCondition is used, which always returns True.
  • gType (Iterable(str) | str) – The user types of the objects starting the valid paths. ‘*’ in gType means all user types.
  • gTypeEnd (Iterable(str) | none | str) – The user types of the objects ending the valid paths. If None, use gType.
  • beginFacing (bool | none) – If True (False), a path is valid only if the starting object is facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as “no restriction”.
  • endFacing (bool | none) – If True (False), a path is valid only if the object ending it are facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as “no restriction”.
Return type:

none
